body:
I'm not comfortable with failing our pipelines because we don't have the latest version of the Insights client. For example, if the latest is a new major, it might require more work to update on our end, which we might not be able to allocate right away.

An alternative, in addition to a "dependabot-like" scheduled PR, could be to still pass the CI but publish a comment on the PR (or add a check like Bundlesize with a warning).
That's fair, I'll look into doing this in a PR instead
